svg.title: AI-Roast-Battle
svg.desc: AI-Roast-Battle: Photo roasts and battles written by Gemini AI, in a Flutter app. What it does: Analyses a photo with Google Gemini and writes a roast in the voice of more than 20 iconic characters. Roast intensity modes, and a Battle mode that compares two photos and picks a winner. Showcase feed with reactions, and one-tap sharing of results as images. Gemini key stays on the server: a Cloud Functions proxy checks Auth and App Check and enforces rate limits in Firestore. Firestore and Storage rules tested in CI; Turkish and English localisation. Built with: Flutter, Dart, flutter_bloc (Cubit), get_it, Firebase Auth, Cloud Firestore, Firebase Storage, Cloud Functions, App Check, Crashlytics, Gemini AI, Hive, Lottie.
